About The Project

Exobiopharma came to Bitz for a visual identity that could carry a biopharmaceutical brand from the lab bench to the shelf. The brief called for a system that reads as scientific and trustworthy without slipping into the sterile, interchangeable language so much of the pharma category defaults to – a wordmark, palette and type system confident enough to hold its own in a crowded, regulation-heavy market.

 
 

Advancing science needed a mark that could carry it

Client

Exobiopharma

Industry

Biopharmaceutical

Services

Brand Identity, Logo Design, Visual System

Studio

Bitz

About Project

We built the identity around a bold, all-caps wordmark set in Poppins Bold, paired with a supporting palette that swings between clinical blue and higher-energy accent tones – a balance meant to say science and confidence in the same breath. Every touchpoint, from the logo construction to packaging and app icon, was built to hold up at both pharmacy-shelf scale and screen scale.

Design System

Here’s a clear breakdown of the logo architecture, colors and typography that shape the brand’s identity

 
 

Logo Usage

Correct placement and clear space across real touchpoints

 
 

EXOBIOPHARMA

Poppins Bold, set in uppercase, carries every headline and the wordmark itself – direct and clinical. Poppins Regular handles body copy, keeping longer passages of scientific and regulatory text easy to read at any size.

Situation

Carrying the identity into icons, packaging and real-world applications

Beyond Design

Designing Exobiopharma meant giving a science-led brand a face it could trust – clear enough for a pharmacy shelf, credible enough for a clinical setting.

Got questions or want to know more?

Drop me a line – I’m always happy to help with any information you need!

About this project

Marsleaders is a virtual world where anything is possible! Consider a location where you can explore new frontiers and chances, put your entrepreneurship talents to the test, and even construct your virtual existence. Of course, it’s a fictitious game, but the rewards for participating are genuine. You can earn incentives redeemed in the real world by holding NFTs (non-fungible tokens) on Earth.

See Live web
 
 

Logomark

There are four logo variants, each suitable for use across different platforms and communications. The design reflects the project’s context, where interactions take place between political figures, giving the logo a solid and authoritative character. At the same time, since the project is an NFT game, this solidity is balanced with a planetary element, adding a more playful and dynamic touch. The patch-like shapes, reminiscent of those often found on the sleeves of the characters’ jackets, further emphasize the visual identity.

Versions of the logo

The primary logo features a planet within a circle, encircled by the project name and three stars. These elements are consistently used across all variations, reinforcing a sense of unity and making them a recognizable part of the branding.

 
 

NFT Artworks

Multiple character variations were sketched, refined, and generated. Author is Xesus Bobomb

Rare Assets

Project features a set of symbols and compositions in diverse futuristic styles

Discord Emojies

Custom Discord emoji animations made to strengthen brand identity.

UI/UX Design

In this project, I designed and developed a website with a strong focus on clean aesthetics and smooth functionality. The goal was to create an engaging digital space that feels both modern and user-friendly. By combining thoughtful UI with seamless UX, the site delivers clarity, flow, and consistency. Every element was crafted to enhance the overall experience while reflecting the brand’s identity.

About The Project

An electric vehicle (EV) charger is a crucial piece of infrastructure for the growing number of electric vehicle owners worldwide. Unlike traditional vehicles thet rely on internal combustion engines and gasoline. electric cars are powered by electricity stored in their batteries. To keep these vehicles charged and ready for the road, EV chargers come into play.

Read More

 
 
Client

BRACE

3D artist

Giorgi Berianidze

Director

Luka Gabidzashvili

Graphic Designers

DAVE | Mariam Ninoshvili

About Project

As part of this project, we crafted every aspect of the branding to reflect the essence of the brand and its mission – advancing EV charging, driving innovation, and bracing for a greener future. Modern elements of the visual identity highlight Brace’s positioning as a modern solution for transportation.

 
 

Design System

Here’s a clear breakdown of the colors, typography, logotype, and logo architecture that shape the brand’s identity

 
 

Social media posts

Design assets

Supporting Materials Developed Throughout the Design Process

Beyond Design

Designing Brace meant shaping more than an identity – it meant giving form to energy, movement, and the promise of cleaner roads ahead.

About this project

Take a step back in time with my latest hobbyist project – a reimagined retro-style radio receiver inspired by the iconic Motorola Transistor. From the stunning 3D model to the carefully selected materials and lighting, every detail was designed to perfection. Get ready to experience nostalgia in a whole new way!

 
 

Reviving the Past: An Adaptation of Classic Design

Blending the best of both worlds, my latest project preserves the retro charm of the classic radio receiver while introducing modern updates that are sure to turn heads. The result is a stunning piece that captures the essence of the past while looking right at home in the present.

Animation

Bringing the retro radio receiver to life! To showcase its workings and breathe new life into the design, I created a captivating animation that highlights every detail. Get ready to experience the magic of this classic piece like never before.

Unleashing the power of creativity with Cerebro – a digital marketing agency that’s breaking boundaries. For this project, I crafted a mesmerizing logo and visual identity that captures the essence of the human brain and seamlessly blends it with the digital world. The result? A stunning piece that’s both captivating and unique

Read more
 
 

Visual identity

Unlocking the potential of Cerebro with a standout logo, pattern, and typography! For this project, I curated a mesmerizing logo that’s perfect for pre-defined cases, along with a stunning pattern that’s sure to turn heads. With the right typography, every element comes together seamlessly to create a visual masterpiece

 

Versions of the logo

Breaking barriers with a logo that adapts to any situation! With Cerebro, I crafted a logo that’s versatile enough to be used both horizontally and vertically. But that’s not all! To make sure it stands out in any setting, I developed multiple color-changing versions that truly make a statement

 
 

variations

Versions of the logo and use on different colored backgrounds

 

 
 

Color palette

Expanding color gamut for Serebro’s true potential – retaining current active color while adding various tones, gradations, and additional colors.

About this project

Introducing Lisi Drive – the ultimate car wash and take-away cafe located near the scenic Liss Lake. To enhance the brand’s identity, I created a unique logo, simple visual identity, and stunning exterior design, complete with stunning renderings of both the building and advertising signage. The result? A brand that perfectly captures the essence of Liss Drive’s unique blend of convenience, quality, and style!

Signpost

Sign design developed with lightbox blocks, logo, and arrow rendering.

Exterior design

Beautified facade with decorations and glass band stickers; 3D rendering with day/night views.
